title: Cobblemon Conquest Project
description: Project for the official mod pack for the Cobblemon Conquest Server (Still in development)
body:
![Server Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/132d9f3dae928640acaef02f8cbd2267c3738e4a.png)

> *Hey there! Welcome to our little corner of the Minecraft universe, built right on top of the absolutely legendary **Cobbleverse** modpack by LUMYMON.* We aren't trying to build a massive mega-corporation server, and we definitely aren't trying to sell you pay-to-win loot crates. We just really, *really* like Pokémon and Minecraft, and wanted to build a cozy, fun, and slightly expanded place to hang out with friends! 

Think of **Cobblemon Conquest** as your favorite local coffee shop... except the barista has a Charizard and the pastries are actually rare candies. ☕🔥

---

### 🎒 The Core Experience First
Instead of reinventing the wheel, our main priority is preserving that pure, amazing **[Cobbleverse](https://www.lumyverse.com/en/cobbleverse/) survival experience** you already love. Go at your own pace, explore the gorgeous biomes, build your base, and enjoy the core pack exactly as it was meant to be played.

But once you've settled in and want to expand your journey, we’ve bolted on some incredible custom features and endgame content!

---

### 🛠️ Our Custom Mod Blueprint (What We Added!)
To give our server its unique flavor, we've carefully selected and configured a handful of amazing additions to run alongside the base pack:

* **🚀 Casino Rocket (Server-Side):** Need a break from training? Head over to our Casino Rocket lounge! Try your luck at fully functional **Slot Machines**, **Blackjack Tables**, or **Gacha Machines**. Don't worry—**absolutely zero real money is allowed here**. It’s 100% powered by your in-game PokéDollars. Double your currency or pull for rare prizes without needing to install extra client-side mods!
* **🛠️ Chiselmon (Cobblemon QOL):** A massive quality-of-life upgrade for your client! Adds an incredible PC Overhaul featuring custom wallpapers, box bookmarks, detailed stat tooltips, a high-tech "Egg Spy" overlay to track hatch progress, and customizable local spawn alerts so you never miss a shiny or legendary near you.
* **🧭 Cobblemon Expeditions:** Ready to put your PC Pokémon to work? Craft a 3x2 multiblock Expedition Board and dispatch your resting team members on timed background missions! Type matchups, IVs, and environmental hazards determine their success. Send them out, claim your loot, and level up your Expedition Rank!
* **👹 Cobblemon Alpha Project:** Think you're the ultimate tracker? Keep your eyes peeled for terrifyingly massive, powerful **Alpha Pokémon** roaming the wild. Defeating or catching them is a true badge of honor.
* **🌲 Cobblemon Safari:** Dive into the Safari zone and capture rare pokemon. Or look for Distortions spawning around you and explore the secrets Giratina has in wait. Or visit the icon Sinnoh Underground and dig for treasure! 
* **⏳ Cobblemon: Extra Paradox Mons:** Time distortions have brought mysterious Past and Future Paradox Pokémon into the world. They are rare, powerful, and waiting for you to discover them.
* **➕ ...And More to Come!** We are constantly listening to feedback and looking for fun, balanced ways to keep the world fresh.

---

### 🏆 End-Game & Hunting Goals
* **👑 A Custom Elite Four:** Once you've mastered the core game, perfected your team, and want a real test of skill, our custom-crafted Elite Four challenge awaits you. It's a fun way to wrap up up the core content with more additions to follow. Bring your absolute best strategy!
* **✨ Shiny Radiants:** Because standard shinies weren't sparkly enough. Keep your eyes peeled for ultra-rare Radiant variants that will genuinely make you do a double-take when they pop up in the wild.
* **🏅 Casual Community Gyms:** Down the road, if you want to test your mettle against other players, we have a relaxed, optional, player-run gym setup for fun community battles.
* **🚫 0% Pay-To-Win, 100% Fun:** You can't buy your way to the top here. The only thing that wins battles is your strategy (and maybe a little bit of RNG luck).

---

### 🌲 Choose Your Vibe (Ideas on What to Do)

Minecraft is a sandbox—there’s no right or wrong way to play here. If you're wondering what your day-to-day life on the server might look like, here are a few paths you can take:

* **The Hunter:** Spend your days tracking down rare **Alpha Monsters** in the wild, or hunting for those ultra-elusive **Shiny Radiants**. 
* **The Tycoon:** Set up a massive apricorn farm, and use chipped to build a beautiful storefront, and run the richest shop in the player economy.
* **The Manager:** Focus on crafting your 3x2 **Expedition Boards**, managing your PC roster, and sending your Pokémon out on remote missions for passive loot while you work on your base.
* **The Strategist:** Dive deep into breeding mechanics, perfect your team's stats, and prepare your squad to challenge the custom **Elite Four**.
* **The Nomad:** Just grab your running shoes, jump into the **Ultra Space** dimension, and explore the far corners of the world to see what you can find.
